# AI Gateway v0.2.1

This patch release improves remote module routing and anonymization rule
compatibility.

## Changes

- Preserve configured base paths when constructing remote module endpoints.
- Accept the `basic` anonymization rule set through the gateway guardrail
  adapter.
- Normalize legacy anonymization rule aliases to the active rule inventory so
  existing configurations continue to mask the intended data.

## Validation

The release is covered by regression tests for remote endpoint construction,
rule-set forwarding, and legacy alias normalization. The release workflow also
runs the complete Go, UI, OpenAPI, PostgreSQL integration, Helm, and container
validation gates before publishing artifacts.

## Upgrade notes

Upgrade the gateway and supporting service charts together to keep their
internal contracts aligned.
